sql_injection.name: SQL Injection
sql_injection.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command allows an attacker to modify the intended SQL query and access or modify data.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements
Apply principle of least privilege for database accounts
Use ORM frameworks that handle parameterization
examples: string query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + userId;
db.execute("DELETE FROM orders WHERE id=" + orderId);
const sql = `SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = '${searchTerm}'`;

xss.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
xss.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation allows attackers to inject malicious scripts.
fix_patterns: Use frameworks that auto-escape by default

hardcoded_credentials.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
hardcoded_credentials.description: Product contains hard-coded credentials such as a password, cryptographic key, or other secret value.
remediation: Never commit credentials to version control

command_injection.name: OS Command Injection
command_injection.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands.
fix_patterns: Use safe exec methods with args array

path_traversal.name: Path Traversal
path_traversal.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory allows attackers to access files outside the intended directory.
remediation: Resolve paths and verify they're within allowed directory
fix_patterns: Resolve and validate path is within allowed directory

not_vulnerable.name: Not Vulnerable
not_vulnerable.description: No vulnerability detected in the code.

insecure_deserialization.name: Insecure Deserialization
insecure_deserialization.description: Deserializing untrusted data can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.
insecure_deserialization.owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
remediation: Never deserialize untrusted data with pickle
If pickle is required, restrict deserializable classes
